name: meetnotes
description: Privacy-first Google Meet caption transcriber (Chrome MV3 extension)

scripts.build: node init && npm run clean && npm run typecheck && vite build && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts && MEETNOTES_ENTRY=bridge vite build --config vite.content.config.ts
scripts.dev: node init && npm run clean && (vite build --watch --mode development & vite build --config vite.content.config.ts --watch --mode development & MEETNOTES_ENTRY=bridge vite build --config vite.content.config.ts --watch --mode development)
scripts.build:web: node init && npm run typecheck && vite build --config vite.web.config.ts
